label: NASA navigation
description: Orion's reconstructed trajectory as reported by NASA. The reference every model is scored against.

label: Earth only
description: Two-body Kepler: Earth as a point mass, nothing else. Blind to the Moon.

label: Earth + oblateness
description: Earth point mass plus J2, the equatorial bulge. Still blind to the Moon.

label: Earth + Moon
description: Adds the Moon's gravity. The first tier that can fly a lunar flyby.

label: Earth + Moon + Sun
description: Adds the Sun's tidal pull on the Earth-Moon-Orion system.
